sections.label: What Is a Dental Check-Up and Clean?

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Is a Dental Check-Up and Clean?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A check-up is a comprehensive examination of your teeth, gums, bite and the soft tissues of your mouth. A professional clean, also known as a scale and polish, removes plaque and hardened tartar from above and just below the gum line, followed by polishing to reduce surface staining.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Together, these appointments help prevent tooth decay and gum disease, two of the most common dental conditions affecting Australians.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Is a Check-Up and Clean Right for You?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Everyone benefits from regular dental visits, including children, teenagers, adults and older adults. Many people attend every six months, although your recommended interval may be shorter or longer depending on your oral health. More frequent visits may be suggested if you:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have a history of gum disease or frequent decay

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Are pregnant, as hormonal changes can affect gum health

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Have diabetes or another condition that influences oral health

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Wear braces, aligners or dentures

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Smoke

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If it has been some time since your last visit, you are very welcome. There is no judgement here, only a fresh start.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Appointment

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Getting to Know You

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We start by asking about your medical history, any concerns you have noticed and your goals for your teeth.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Examination

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We carefully check each tooth for decay, cracks and wear, assess existing fillings and crowns, measure your gum health and examine your tongue, cheeks and palate. Our intra-oral camera allows us to show you close-up images on screen.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Digital X-Rays

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Where needed, low-dose digital X-rays help us see between teeth and beneath the surface. X-rays are recommended based on your individual risk rather than at every visit.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Scale and Polish

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Plaque and tartar are gently removed with ultrasonic and hand instruments, and your teeth are polished. A fluoride treatment may be recommended to strengthen enamel.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Your Personalised Plan

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We explain our findings, answer your questions and provide tips for your home care. If any treatment is recommended, such as white fillings or gum and periodontal treatment, we explain your options and costs.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Aftercare and Ongoing Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Brush twice daily for two minutes with a soft toothbrush and fluoride toothpaste, and clean between your teeth once a day with floss or interdental brushes. Limit sugary snacks and drinks, drink plenty of water and avoid smoking. Book your next visit at the interval recommended for you.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for Your Check-Up and Clean

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for Your Check-Up and Clean

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We take the time to explain what we see, using intra-oral photographs and digital imaging so you can understand your oral health. Our team works gently, and we offer noise-cancelling headphones and ceiling-mounted televisions to help you relax. Families may also be eligible for the Child Dental Benefits Schedule.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How often should I have a check-up and clean?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Many people attend every six months, but the right interval depends on your oral health. We will recommend a schedule that suits you.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Does a scale and clean hurt?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Most patients find cleans comfortable. If your gums are inflamed or your teeth are sensitive, you may feel some tenderness. Let us know, and we will adjust our approach.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Do I need X-rays at every visit?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: No. X-rays are recommended based on your individual needs and risk of decay or other concerns.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I claim my check-up through my health fund?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Most extras policies with general dental cover provide rebates for check-ups and cleans. We process claims on the spot through HICAPS.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: It has been years since my last visit. Is that okay?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Absolutely. We welcome patients regardless of how long it has been. Our focus is on helping you move forward comfortably.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How long does a check-up and clean take?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Most appointments take between 30 and 60 minutes, depending on your needs and whether X-rays are required.
